events.summary: ⭐ We want to share that we have started a new visual direction for Mythsfall.After reviewing the feedback we received, we decided to move the game’s visuals toward a more consistent, more atmospheric, and hand crafted style. As one of the first steps in this process, we are currently working on new main menu drafts. Our menu is still a work in progress and does not represent the final version of the game.
